title: Winding numbers add: 3 − 1 = 2
caption: A loop's class in π₁(circle) ≅ ℤ is its net winding number: three anticlockwise turns count +3, one clockwise turn counts −1, so the loop is homotopic to going round twice.
alt: A number line from −1 to 4: a jump of +3 from 0 to 3 for the anticlockwise turns, then a jump of −1 back to 2 for the clockwise turn.
description: Each anticlockwise circuit counts +1 and each clockwise circuit counts −1.
The class of the loop is 2 in ℤ.
